senses.gloss: हत- + अश्व हत- + अश्व (vb. हन्), adj. having the horses killed.
हत- + आश हत- + आश (vb. हन्), adj. hopeless, desperate, Mālav. 36, 20.

हताश हताश, i. e. हत-आश, (see हन् and आशा), m.
 1. Hopeless, desponding.
 2. Weak.
 3. Barren.
 4. Cruel, merciless.
 5. Vile, wicked, Vikr. 8, 9 (Prākṛ.).
हत- + बान्धव हत- + बान्धव (vb. हन्), adj. without relations, Cāṇ. 6 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, p. 407.
हत-सर्व- + योध हत-सर्व- + योध, adj. with all the warriors killed.
हत- + शेष हत- + शेष, adj. the remainder of the killed, i. e. those who had avoided being killed, Pañc. 122, 24.

हतक हत + क (vb. हन्),
 I. adj. Miserable (?), Mālat. 87, 3.
 II. m. A coward, Utt. Rāmac. 30, 7.

हति हति, i. e. हन् + ति, f.
 1. Striking; in कल-, f. Ploughing.
 2. Destroying, removing, Bhartṛ. 3, 100.
 --Cf. A.S. dynt; see हन्.

हत्नु हत्नु, i. e. हन् + त्नु, m.
 1. A weapon.
 2. Sickness.

हत्य हत्य, i. e. हन् + त्य, n., and f. या, Killing, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14 [] (n.); Pañc. i. d. 306 (I read तस्य हत्या तदुत्थाना, The murder of that man has its origin in this person, i. e. his death is caused by that person, by trusting to whom he has found it; but cf. also Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2850); 221, 14 (f.).
 --Comp.
